```python
from pm4py.objects.petri_net.obj import PetriNet, Marking
from pm4py.objects.petri_net.utils import petri_utils

# -----------------------------
# Build the Petri net
# -----------------------------
net = PetriNet(name="insurance_claim_management")

# Places
p_start = PetriNet.Place("p_start")              # new claim arrives
p_cr = PetriNet.Place("p_cr")                    # after claim registration
p_dv = PetriNet.Place("p_dv")                    # after document verification
p_rds = PetriNet.Place("p_rds")                  # documents re-submitted
p_fc = PetriNet.Place("p_fc")                    # after fraud check
p_ii = PetriNet.Place("p_ii")                    # after in-depth investigation
p_ca = PetriNet.Place("p_ca")                    # after claim assessment
p_ap = PetriNet.Place("p_ap")                    # after approval
p_p = PetriNet.Place("p_p")                      # after payment
p_n = PetriNet.Place("p_n")                      # after notification
p_cl = PetriNet.Place("p_cl")                    # claim closed / final state

# Add places to net
net.places.update({
    p_start, p_cr, p_dv, p_rds, p_fc, p_ii, p_ca, p_ap, p_p, p_n, p_cl
})

# Transitions
t_cr = PetriNet.Transition("t_cr", "CR")
t_dv = PetriNet.Transition("t_dv", "DV")
t_rds = PetriNet.Transition("t_rds", "RDS")
t_fc = PetriNet.Transition("t_fc", "FC")
t_ii = PetriNet.Transition("t_ii", "II")
t_ca = PetriNet.Transition("t_ca", "CA")
t_ap = PetriNet.Transition("t_ap", "AP")
t_p = PetriNet.Transition("t_p", "P")
t_n = PetriNet.Transition("t_n", "N")
t_cl = PetriNet.Transition("t_cl", "CL")

# Add transitions to net
net.transitions.update({t_cr, t_dv, t_rds, t_fc, t_ii, t_ca, t_ap, t_p, t_n, t_cl})

# -----------------------------
# Arcs
# -----------------------------
# Start -> Claim Registration
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_start, t_cr, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_cr, p_cr, net)

# Claim Registration -> Document Verification
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_cr, t_dv, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_dv, p_dv, net)

# If documents are incomplete, go to Re-Document Submission and back to DV
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_dv, t_rds, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_rds, p_rds, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_rds, t_dv, net)   # loop back to document verification

# After DV, proceed to Fraud Check
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_dv, t_fc, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_fc, p_fc, net)

# If fraud doubts arise, do in-depth investigation and return to FC
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_fc, t_ii, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_ii, p_ii, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_ii, t_fc, net)    # loop back to fraud check

# After FC, proceed to Claim Assessment
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_fc, t_ca, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_ca, p_ca, net)

# Approval, Payment, Notification, Closure
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_ca, t_ap, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_ap, p_ap, net)

petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_ap, t_p, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_p, p_p, net)

petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_p, t_n, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_n, p_n, net)

petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_n, t_cl, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_cl, p_cl, net)

# -----------------------------
# Initial and final markings
# -----------------------------
im = Marking()
im[p_start] = 1

fm = Marking()
fm[p_cl] = 1
```

### Notes
- The net models the main process flow: **CR → DV → FC → CA → AP → P → N → CL**.
- The **RDS** loop allows repeated document resubmission before proceeding.
- The **II** loop allows repeated in-depth investigations before proceeding.
- The initial marking `im` contains one token in `p_start`.
- The final marking `fm` contains one token in `p_cl`, representing a closed claim.
